title: Event center
hint: What has happened on the platform recently: expiries, image changes, collection failures and cluster alerts, on one timeline.

empty.title: No events in this period
empty.quiet: Nothing expired, changed, failed to collect or alerted in the last {{days}} days. That is good news — but if you are chasing something that already happened, widen the time range and look again.
empty.filtered: No events match the current filters. Widen the source or level — when looking only at Critical, many useful leads sit at Warning.

error.title: The event center could not be loaded

truncated: Too many events — only {{shown}} of {{total}} returned (limit {{limit}}). This is NOT the full list; narrow the time range or filter by source.
merged: {{count}} duplicate events were merged into the ×N rows (same object reporting the same thing repeatedly). The smaller total is expected, nothing was lost.
